confirmation_policy: All Train and prior equal-factor outcomes are known development evidence. User explicitly authorized this distinct one-candidate OLS experiment. No unseen holdout, no Historical Valid/Valid or saved Valid artifacts.

feature_definitions.components: Exact copied dm_slow_mom60_equal Size z_size, Illiquidity z_amihud, MOM60 residual60/skip1→centered daily rank→EWMA(.25). No component change.
feature_definitions.inputs: Each final component same-date average-tie percentile p→2*(p-mean(p)); identical saved factor_ranks.parquet.
feature_definitions.label: Provided target_1day_train Return, raw t+1→t+2 Open market residual; finite labels only. No label rank/zscore or winsorization.
feature_definitions.OLS: Intercept+SizeRank+IlliquidityRank+MOM60Rank. Minimize pooled mature stock-day squared raw residual errors. Equal stock-day weights; no per-day weighting, regularization, coefficient clipping, sign constraints or extra smoothing.
feature_definitions.maturity: Training signal date position+2 must be strictly before year first prediction exchange session; same-calendar t+2, terminal2 unknown labels excluded.
feature_definitions.warmup: 2008 neutral score0; first annual model2009. Annual fits2009-2010 only establish continuous holdings before2011 evaluation; no early-period model selection. Rank-deficient warmup uses fixed lstsq minimum-norm result, rank/singular values logged.

model: Ordinary least squares, 4 coefficients (intercept+3 ranks), annual expanding fit; one candidate
selection_rule: Conjunction of unchanged DM-20261003-05 user gates vs SLOW. POOLED and EX2016 NetSR>SLOW, annual net>=SLOW, Long net>0, Short net>=SLOW, MaxDD magnitude<=SLOW, turnover<=1.5*SLOW, incremental gross>incremental cost; >=4/5 full-year NetSR improvements, primary pooled bootstrap lower>0. OLS/EQUAL/MOM comparison descriptive; no rescue or changing estimator based on outcomes.

bootstrap.method: paired circular moving block on realized eligible walk-forward daily net P/L, percentile CI, no bootstrap refit
